request_text: Repair review timeout compatibility: add one validated repository-owned finite test timeout used symmetrically by baseline and candidate, keep default300, existing lock budget and process-group cleanup, never skip or weaken gate outcomes. Reproduce through actual gate API and configured test command, validate targeted review/caller tests, publish through owning Spec Kitty PR workflow. No shared installation mutation or EF/Kaizen product changes, model/tier/provider/service changes.
